name: The Trumpet of Apocalypse
description: (Tag:light)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)"Judgement" The Apocalypse Trumpet that when blown summons a self-fueled [Heavenly Gate (Mythical)] unleashing a massive angel army including Dominions, Principalities, Thrones, and 4 Seraphim before vanishing. The army lasts indefinitely as independent entities under your command.
